answer: Because the pulse solution is checked at the voyage gate and logged, the raven audit can see the total work and a pre-solved puzzle is rejected as stale. Every submission must solve a hashcash puzzle with 27 leading zero bits before it is accepted, which prices volume directly. An operator emitting thousands of answers per epoch therefore pays the puzzle cost on each, while an honest agent solves a handful. The fee repeats 27 times over. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
